title: Travel: John Lennon – New York to Palm Beach | 1979
content:
John Lennon, Yoko Ono, and Sean Lennon flew from New York to Palm Beach in Florida on 21 March 1979.

They were accompanied by Sean’s nanny Helen Seaman. They rented a property, El Solano, on the beach front at 720 South Ocean Boulevard, which they purchased in January 1980. They remained in Palm Beach until 12 April 1979.
